slides.texte_overlay:
skills that make you
dangerously
magnetic
Being genuinely happy for others. Celebrating friends' wins without jealousy is rare. People are drawn to someone who makes them feel good about themselves.
Having a life you're excited about. Projects, trips, training goals. Passion is contagious, and people want to be around someone who's going somewhere.
Making people laugh, including at yourself. Light humour relaxes a room. A man who doesn't take himself too seriously is easy to like.
Being calm under pressure. When plans fall apart, stay steady and find a solution. People naturally gather around the calmest person in a storm.
Try this for 30 days: five minutes a day of history, art or science. Always having something fascinating to share draws people in.
slides.texte_sophia: Try this for 30 days: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Always having something fascinating to share draws people in.

slides.texte_overlay: Remembering what matters to people. Their sister's wedding, their job interview. Asking about it later makes people feel truly seen.
Being the same with everyone. Kind to the waiter, kind to the boss. Consistency makes people trust you, and trust is what keeps them close.
